sets.name: 2.48s Relic | Melded Speed
sets.description:
This gearset melds Spell Speed into gear to achieve 2.48 GCD, making it incompatible with 2.50 GCD gearsets on other casters such as PCT and RDM.

This gearset is only recommended for current-tier max level content such as the Arcadion Savage raids and Dancing Mad (Ultimate).

sets.name: 2.48s Relic | Sync + 2.50 Friendly
sets.description:
This gearset puts Spell Speed in the weapon to achieve 2.48 GCD on SMN while letting other casters such as PCT and RDM remain at 2.50 GCD.

It is level sync friendly and should properly scale enough speed to land 6 Impulses in any content.
